messages:
Lina - Support: FYI escalated from customer — their invoice shows ~3x embedding units vs what the dashboard reports. They attached request examples and said rerank calls are involved. :grimacing:
Lina - Support: They gave a payload with a batched embeddings request + a separate rerank pairwise call that runs on the same inputs. They say dashboard shows ~1200 vectors but invoice billed ~3600 units.
Jon M (eng-ml): Can you paste the raw request bodies (anonymized) and any request_ids? Need to trace in logs. :eyes:
Lina - Support: Pasted below (customer redacted token):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-large-v2",
  "input": ["long document text... (truncated)", "short summary", ""]
}

POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rerank-pairwise-v1",
  "queries": ["short summary"],
  "documents": ["long document text... (truncated)", "short summary", ""]
}
```
Lina - Support: They also said some inputs are empty strings and that they batch inputs (size ~64) before sending.
Jon M (eng-ml): Interesting — two red flags: 1) pairwise rerank will bill per pair (query x doc) 2) empty string handling changed in last release (we started returning zero-vectors but may still count them at metering time).
Jon M (eng-ml): I pulled the internal logs for request_id X-ABC-123: embeddings call created 3 vectors (including zero-vector for empty input). Rerank pairwise call expanded to 3 docs x 1 query = 3 pairwise ops. But invoice line shows 9 units — looks like counts were multiplied again during async batch replay. :thinking:
Jon M (eng-ml): Repro steps I ran locally:
```bash
# reproduce locally (sanitized)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","input":["A long doc...","short"," "]}'
# then rerank pairwise on same inputs
```
Jon M (eng-ml): With batch replay enabled, our batching layer was deduping by fingerprint, but empty-string vectors fingerprinted inconsistently, causing them to be re-enqueued per-chunk. That generated duplicate meter events on the billing side.
Kevin B (billing): Thanks — from billing logs I can see duplicate meter events for that account around 2026-03-09T14:12Z. I put a temporary hold on invoicing for the disputed window and created a credit hold ticket. Will need eng confirmation before applying credits. :white_check_mark:
Lina - Support: Customer wants a quick mitigation and a reconciled number so they can close their finance ticket.
Jon M (eng-ml): Short-term: we can 1) issue a one-off credit for the duplicate meter events, 2) push a hotfix to normalize empty inputs so they produce stable fingerprints (and ensure deduper ignores zero-vectors), 3) add a logging flag to surface replay/batching duplicates in dashboard.
Kevin B (billing): I can offer provisional credit equal to duplicated meter units (we estimate ~2400 units) pending final audit. Please confirm exact meter_event_ids to reverse.
Jon M (eng-ml): Confirmed meter_event_ids attached in DM to Kevin (IDs: mtr-9921, mtr-9922, mtr-9922-dup). Also filing ENG issue: INFR-5123 to add a unit test and patch. Rolling hotfix to canary later today.
ops-bot: invoice_webhook: {"acct":"acct-xxxx","invoice_id":"inv-2026-0309-77","lines":3,"total_units":3600} (automated)
Lina - Support: Customer updated saying they saw an unexpected dim change earlier this month too (their embedding vector dimension reported 1536 in dashboard, but their local code expected 768). Could that be related?
Jon M (eng-ml): Separate but related — model embedding config change (v2 rollout) updated dimension to 1536. If their client-side code assumed 768 and re-batched/duplicated inputs to compensate, that could have amplified counts. I'll flag product to include clearer release notes and add a dimension check in SDKs to warn. Filing follow-up: DOCS-204.
Kevin B (billing): I'll keep the provisional credit on hold until hotfix verification. If ENG confirms duplicates were generated by server-side bug, billing will apply credit and reissue invoice.
Lina - Support: Action items: (1) ENG hotfix + canary (Jon), (2) billing provisional credit + audit (Kevin), (3) support follow-up + credit confirmation to customer (Lina).
Jon M (eng-ml): Hotfix deployed to canary at 1814008923, observed no duplicate meter events in canary replay. Will merge to prod after 6h burn.
Kevin B (billing): Noted. I'll schedule the audit for tomorrow and message the customer with provisional credit numbers.
Lina - Support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks team :v:
